title: Concept: Loggly customer token in a response
description: A Loggly collector URL with a customer token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The customer token authorises writes to the account's log stream, so leaked tokens let an attacker inject entries that overwrite the timeline of an incident review.
applicability: Deployments that render a Loggly collector URL with a customer token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The customer token authorises writes to the account's log stream, so leaked tokens let an attacker inject entries that overwrite the timeline of an incident review.
